name: dev-team-maturity-performance-skills
description: Governed Claude Agent Skills for engineering delivery maturity analysis: deterministic KPIs, rule-based pattern detection, and catalog-only intervention recommendations from Jira data.

plugins.name: maturity-engine
plugins.description: Computes 5 deterministic delivery KPIs, detects diagnostic patterns, scores team maturity (0-100), and recommends interventions from a fixed catalog.

plugins.name: maturity-onboarding
plugins.description: Guides a CTO or consultant through setting up org-specific KPI definitions, thresholds, and data-quality notes for maturity-engine.
